verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents 'plugin marketplaces' as catalogs providing 'centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates' (anthropic-skills-docs-8, -36, -48), and the official GitHub repo anthropics/skills acts as a browsable list of example skills you can register/add before installing (anthropic-skills-gh-1, -2, -4, -6). This supports browsing/discovery before install, but there's no evidence of a searchable UI, leaderboard, ratings, or popularity metrics — discovery is largely via CLI commands or reading a repo's folder listing rather than a rich marketplace search experience. Missing for 10: dedicated searchable marketplace UI, ranking/leaderboard or quality signals, independent confirmation of catalog usability.
